//: Copy to server/sandbox.config.json (or set CCSERVER_SANDBOX_CONFIG) to customize the sandbox.
//docker: true (default): start an isolated rootless dockerd inside the sandbox. false: no docker (lighter, no rootlesskit).
//persistentHome: true (default): keep a persistent writable HOME per project (under ~/.local/share/ccserver-sandbox/home/<project>) so tools/caches installed inside the sandbox survive a session relaunch. A launch dialog offers to reuse the previous sandbox or start fresh (which wipes that HOME). false: legacy fresh-tmpfs HOME every session.
//gpg: true: forward the host gpg-agent (bind ~/.gnupg + the live agent/keyboxd sockets) so commit signing works inside the sandbox using the host's key/token. Coexists with docker. Default false.
//gitBroker: true (default): git HTTPS/SSH access inside the sandbox is scoped to the repos actually related to the session (its own remotes + checked-out submodules, computed once at launch). `gh` is not disabled but rewired: gh invocations are relayed to the host broker, which executes a safelisted subset of subcommands for real (pr/issue/release/workflow/repo-view) against the same allow-list, and refuses everything else (gh api, gh auth, gh repo clone/fork/create, etc.) -- see README 'gh broker' for the exact list. No config needed for the common case -- this replaces the old approach of binding ~/.config/gh and ~/.ssh directly, which is no longer supported (those paths are never exposed, regardless of this flag or of `binds` below). Set false to turn off the broker/gate entirely (git still works, just unscoped if sshAgent is also on; gh runs unwrapped but has no credentials since ~/.config/gh stays blocked). NOT a hard boundary when docker:true (the default) AND sshAgent:true: a container started via `docker run` inside the sandbox doesn't inherit the ssh/gh wrappers and can mount the forwarded ssh-agent socket directly, bypassing the scoping. See README 'Known limitations'.
//forceSandbox: false (default): the client decides per session whether to run inside the sandbox (bwrap). true: forbid launching the agent or a shell outside the sandbox entirely -- every session is forced sandboxed, the per-session UI toggle is overridden, and a launch is REFUSED (instead of falling back to a direct unsandboxed spawn) when the sandbox is unavailable (bwrap not installed, or Windows). It also blocks the /usage background capture's direct-launch fallback. bwrap (bubblewrap) must be installed on the host for any session to start.
//sshAgent: true: forward the host's ssh-agent socket (auto-discovered, preferring one with keys loaded; override with env.SSH_AUTH_SOCK) into the sandbox as SSH_AUTH_SOCK. Only needed for SSH git remotes or running `ssh` directly inside the sandbox -- HTTPS git is already fully brokered by gitBroker without it, and commit signing is the separate gpg flag above. Default false: a forwarded agent is standing access to the host's real keys for the whole sandboxed process, not just git, so leave it off unless you actually need it. See README 'Known limitations' for the docker+gitBroker+sshAgent bypass.
//binds: Extra host paths exposed inside the sandbox, on top of the project dir + ~/.claude + ~/.claude.json (and, with gpg:true, ~/.gnupg). mode: 'ro' (default) or 'rw'. Missing sources are skipped. ~ expands to your home. ~/.ssh and ~/.config/gh are always blocked here (see gitBroker above), so don't list them.
//env: Extra environment variables set inside the sandbox (applied last, so they override defaults). e.g. force a specific SSH_AUTH_SOCK.
//claudeBin: How to launch claude. Default: auto — resolve 'claude' on PATH and, if it's a wrapper to the real binary (e.g. /usr/bin/claude -> /opt/claude-code/bin/claude), expose that install dir in the sandbox automatically. Set this only if claude lives somewhere the auto-detect misses, or to pin a specific build. Absolute path recommended. Env var CCSERVER_CLAUDE_BIN overrides this. (opencode and copilot are auto-resolved from PATH/~/.opencode/bin and ~/.local/bin respectively; there is no per-app bin setting for them.)
//defaultApp: Which agent CLI a new session launches when the client doesn't request one (legacy scheduled prompts, or a browser tab that hasn't picked one yet). 'claude' (default), 'opencode' or 'copilot'. The launch UI's own choice (remembered per browser) always wins once made; this only seeds that choice on first load and covers server-side fallback paths. Combo (group) members never use it — groups default to claude and refuse copilot.
//showUsage: true (default): the client shows the top-bar Usage button (Claude Code /usage spend). false: hide it entirely. The button is also hidden automatically when claude is not installed on this server (the /usage capture could never succeed).
//hiddenApps: [] (default): agent CLI ids ('claude', 'opencode', 'copilot', 'codex') to remove entirely from every launch picker (single-launch modal, combo role pickers, worker preset management, meta-agent launch, the Usage button's app tabs) -- e.g. CLIs installed on this host but that you haven't actually contracted for. Unlike an app the server just can't find (still shown greyed out with a 'サーバーに未インストール' tooltip), a hidden app never appears at all; there is no partial/greyed hide mode. Unknown entries are ignored. The server refuses to start if this hides every agent CLI actually installed here (nothing would be launchable) -- leave at least one selectable.
//usageMcp: false (default): do not inject the ccserver-usage get_usage MCP into Claude sessions. Set true to opt in. This is independent of the Usage button above.
//metaAgentMcp: false (default): do not host the ccserver-meta MCP broker. Set true to opt in. ccserver-meta is a PRIVILEGED server-management toolset (list/launch/close sessions, launch/destroy groups, delete sandboxes, manage presets and project labels); destructive calls additionally require human approval through a browser banner dialog before they run. When enabled, the toolset is injected ONLY into a session explicitly launched with isMetaAgent:true (e.g. POST /api/sessions with isMetaAgent:true) -- never into regular sessions or group members. Such sessions are always forced into the fixed project-outside directory ~/.local/share/ccserver-sandbox/meta-agent (client cwd is ignored) and started via the dedicated "⌘ メタエージェント" button.
//reviewerMcp: false (default): do not host the ccserver-reviewer MCP broker. Set true to opt in. run_review launches a disposable headless session against a fresh, throwaway git worktree (never the caller's own cwd) and drives it through /code-review, for a local ref/branch/PR/uncommitted diff. Unlike ccserver-meta, it is injected into ANY session -- shells and copilot excluded, groups/workers included -- since reviewing code needs no special privilege beyond spawning a sandboxed session. Job status/results are queryable via list_reviews/get_review and persist in the SQLite pr_reviews table across a restart.
//notify: ccserver-notify MCP (通知用, 下記 README)。discordWebhook: https:// の Discord webhook URL (空文字で無効)。設定するとエージェントの notify ツールが Discord へ通知を送れる。CCSERVER_DISCORD_WEBHOOK 環境変数で上書き可。subscriptions: 初期購読 (bootstrap)。https:// の webhook URL の配列。購読ゼロかつ discordWebhook 未設定かつ vikunja 未設定なら MCP は注入されない。hostname: 通知フッターのホスト名を固定したい場合のみ (未設定なら OS の hostname、CCSERVER_HOSTNAME 環境変数が最優先)。attribution: false にすると通知ペイロード末尾の "_from: host · project · group · session" フッターを丸ごと無効化 (既定 true)。

notify.//vikunja: notify 呼び出しごとに Vikunja タスクを作成/更新する (Discord/webhook と並行配信、失敗してもエージェント側にはエラーを返さない)。baseUrl (https:// のみ) と apiToken の両方が設定されていれば有効になり、Discord/購読が空でも notify MCP 自体が注入される。apiToken は秘匿値なので、ここに書く代わりに環境変数 CCSERVER_VIKUNJA_API_TOKEN 経由を強く推奨 (sandbox.config.json は .gitignore 済みだが、それでも平文保存はできるだけ避ける)。baseUrl は CCSERVER_VIKUNJA_BASE_URL、projectId は CCSERVER_VIKUNJA_PROJECT_ID で上書き可。projectId 未設定だとタスク作成は行われない (warning ログのみ)。timeoutSeconds (既定15秒) はリクエストごとのタイムアウト。verifyTls: false で自己署名証明書のインスタンスを許容 (既定 true、無闇に false にしない)。statusLabelPrefix はラベル名の prefix (既定 'status-')。buckets.doing/buckets.todo は Kanban バケット名 (既定 'Doing'/'To-Do')。Claude が作業中 (level: info) は buckets.doing へ、それ以外 (success/warning/error、= 人間の番) は buckets.todo へタスクを移動する。無ければ自動作成する。CCSERVER_VIKUNJA_BUCKET_DOING / CCSERVER_VIKUNJA_BUCKET_TODO で上書き可。タスクを done (完了) にする操作は行わない -- 人間が Vikunja 上で確認して手動で done にする運用。

//federation: 拠点間ペアリング (下記 README「拠点間 (federation) ペアリング」)。requireTokenForPairing: true にすると、ペアリング開始リクエスト (bootstrap) にだけこのインスタンスの CCSERVER_TOKEN の提示を必須にする (既定 false)。あくまでスパム対策で、トークンが合っていても双方向の人間承認は省略されない。機能自体の有効/無効はここではなく CCSERVER_FEDERATION_PORT 環境変数で制御する。
